heading: Journey
subline: Not a straight line, but always moving forward.

chapters.label: Explore
chapters.title: Code, commerce, and a camera
chapters.description: Tried web and mobile programming at Purwadhika, ran an e-commerce store, and started taking freelance design and photo/video work.

chapters.label: Start
chapters.title: University and a first organization
chapters.description: Entered university to study Digital Business at UBM, and joined an organization for the first time as a member of the animation sub-division, editing video for social media.

chapters.label: Rise
chapters.title: Head of the Creative Division
chapters.description: Became Head of the Creative Division at HIMA EXODUS, leading the team that produces the organization's social media content.

chapters.label: Lead
chapters.title: Chairperson of HIMA EXODUS
chapters.description: Responsible for the organization's performance and for making sure the work plan runs.

closing.quote: In high school I turned down the chance to be chairperson because I wasn't confident. Three years after joining my first organization, I became one.
